points.label: Labor, danger, and weakness
points.left: Inherited credentials are counted loss for knowing Christ. Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe. if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
points.right: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I. I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
